draft.heroMessage: Specializing in North Idaho's Silver Valley real estate, Cindy Carlson offers unmatched experience and heartfelt service.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Cindy Carlson Realty, where your real estate needs in North Idaho meet local expertise and friendly, honest guidance.
draft.tagline: Local Roots. Lasting Relationships. Trusted Results.
draft.aboutParagraph: As Broker and owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, Cindy Carlson brings nearly two decades of real estate expertise to the Silver Valley and North Idaho. Cindy and her family have called this beautiful area home for over 40 years, and her passion for the community shines through in her work and volunteer leadership. Whether it’s your first home, a business opportunity, or the perfect property for your next adventure, Cindy’s door is always open—with the assurance of integrity, diligence, and deep local knowledge.
draft.conciergeLine: Questions about the Silver Valley or ready to take the next step? Reach out to Cindy today for personalized service.
draft.contactLine: Call or email Cindy Carlson for trusted advice and expert support in your real estate journey.
draft.tone: Welcoming, knowledgeable, and rooted in community with a sincere commitment to client service.

THE AREA
North Idaho’s Silver Valley
Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
ABOUT
Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.
